name: Himalayan Slope Instability & Landslide Trigger Model

symptoms.label: Intense Convective Precipitation
symptoms.description: Short-duration intense rainfall exceeding soil infiltration threshold

symptoms.label: Antecedent Monsoon Saturation
symptoms.description: Continuous 7-day rainfall saturating deep colluvium matrix

symptoms.label: Volumetric Soil Moisture Saturation (>85%)
symptoms.description: Pore water pressure accumulation reducing effective normal stress

symptoms.label: Tension Crack & Escarpment Fissuring
symptoms.description: Visible longitudinal tension fissures propagating along crown of slope

symptoms.label: InSAR Line-of-Sight Deformation (>12 mm)
symptoms.description: Interferometric SAR fringe decorrelation and active slope downslope velocity

symptoms.label: Precursory Rock Chatter & Pebble Spalling
symptoms.description: Localized rockfall events preceding major slope failure mass movement

symptoms.label: Roadside Drainage Chute Failure
symptoms.description: Blockage of hillside catch-drains causing unchannelized slope sheet runoff

symptoms.label: Teesta River Toe Undercutting & Scour
symptoms.description: High-velocity river hydro-scour eroding basal support of the colluvial toe

causes.label: Steep Escarpment Topography (>32°)
causes.description: Gravity shear stress exceeding critical repose angle of weathered mantle

causes.label: High Antecedent Precipitation
causes.description: Multi-day monsoon rainfall trigger exceeding empirical GSI/IMD threshold

causes.label: Saturated Soil / Weak Colluvium
causes.description: Loss of soil cohesion due to high volumetric moisture saturation

causes.label: Phyllite / Schist Joint Planes & Shear Fractures
causes.description: Daling group fragile metamorphic lithology with unfavorable slope-parallel foliation

causes.label: Toe Cutting & Road Alignment Excavation
causes.description: NH-10 bench excavation debuttressing steep valley hillslopes

causes.label: Vegetation Loss on Slope Mantle
causes.description: Loss of root reinforcement and increased surface erosion runoff velocity
